topic: Discover a merchant's retail stores with UCP location search and lookup
caption:
AI shopping is getting a little more local.

Shopify has added location search and lookup capabilities that help compatible shopping agents discover a merchant’s physical retail stores.

For developers, two tools matter:

• `search_locations` helps an agent discover locations using supported queries and filters.
• `lookup_locations` retrieves details for locations the agent already knows.

That distinction sounds small, but it changes how you might design a shopping flow. An assistant could help someone find a relevant store before directing them toward the next step.

There’s an important limit: discovering a location does not confirm stock, pickup eligibility, or fulfillment. Those still need to be checked through the appropriate commerce flow.

I’d treat this as a useful building block for location-aware shopping, not an end-to-end retail solution.

Official details: https://shopify.dev/changelog/discover-a-merchant-s-retail-stores-with-ucp-location-search-and-lookup
